title: SAML 2.0 setup assistant with metadata probing & delegated admin consent
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Customers frequently mis-configure SAML metadata (mismatched entityIDs, expired certs, incorrect ACS URLs) which causes onboarding friction and increases support load. We need a guided setup assistant that performs safe metadata probing, validates signatures and certificates, surfaces clear remediation steps, and supports a delegated admin consent flow so that non-SRE admins can accept metadata changes without requiring org owners.

Solution overview: Build a setup assistant flow that (1) accepts metadata URL or XML upload, (2) performs a non-destructive probe (fetch, validate signatures, check cert expiry/fingerprint, canonicalize entityID and ACS endpoints), (3) runs a dry-run assertion simulation against a test SP request to detect clock skew and attribute mapping mismatches, (4) surfaces validation results with suggested fixes, and (5) optionally creates a pending connector that requires delegated admin consent to finalize. The assistant will emit structured audit events at each step and integrate with RBAC v2 so only users with the "saml_delegated_admin" role can approve connectors.

Important constraints and safety: The probe must never accept unsigned metadata by default. Network fetches should run in a short-lived sandbox with timeouts and rate limits. We will not persist raw certificate private material (only certs/public keys and computed fingerprints). All operator actions (create, approve, reject, re-probe) must be logged to the audit log with request IDs and user IDs.

Out-of-scope for initial iteration: full IdP federation management, automated reconciliation of metadata rotations across customers, and step-up MFA during consent (MFA may be added later).
acceptance_criteria: Assistant accepts metadata URL or XML upload and sanitizes input without crashing
Probe fetch runs and returns machine-readable checks: entityID match, signature validity, cert expiry, certificate fingerprint (SHA256), ACS URL whitelist checks
Dry-run assertion simulator reports common mapping issues and clock skew warnings
Pending connector record created when 'Require delegated consent' is enabled, and cannot be used for auth until approved
Delegated admin role mapping enforced via RBAC v2: only users with 'saml_delegated_admin' can approve connectors
Every user action in the flow emits an audit event with consistent schema and is visible in Console audit UI
Errors and remediation steps shown to customer with links to docs and one-click retry for fetch
Automated e2e tests and unit coverage for probe logic and audit emission in CI
implementation_notes: Backend: new /saml/probe endpoint that performs metadata fetch + validation in an isolated worker with 5s DNS timeout and 10s total timeout
Validation: use existing xmlsec bindings for signature verification and a certstore module to compute fingerprint and expiry checks
Database: pending_connectors table with status {pending, approved, rejected}, store canonicalized metadata and fingerprints, do not store raw full-xml blobs longer than 7 days
RBAC: integrate with RBAC v2 'saml_delegated_admin' permission; add a console action to grant this role to a team or user

Audit: emit audit events 'saml.probe.request', 'saml.probe.result', 'saml.connector.create', 'saml.connector.approve', 'saml.connector.reject' with metadata: user_id, connector_id, request_id, outcome
UX: show a diff view between current metadata (if any) and uploaded metadata highlighting entityID, certificates, ACS URLs
Security: require organization-level feature flag 'enable_delegated_saml_consent' to be on before showing consent flow to admins
Telemetry: record probe failure reasons for product analytics (signature_invalid, cert_expired, fetch_timeout, ata_mismatch)
